data.name: Os Segredos de Ezequiel
data.detailed_description:
Humanity struggles to survive a devastating crisis. Four marked champions emerge with the power to rewrite the future.
You will guide them through a world full of dangers, mysteries and difficult choices.

Build your party. Choose your path.

Fight in turn-based battles, choose from eight playable classes and explore five distinct regions filled with enemies, bosses and creatures inspired by Brazilian folklore.

Explore by day or risk the dangers of the night. Talk to those you meet, uncover the truth behind this world and make decisions with irreversible consequences.

But remember: nothing is quite as simple as it seems. In a world made by twilight , one can never be certain where the light comes from.

data.short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG where four marked champions journey across five distinct regions. Choose from eight classes, build your party, fight monsters and bosses inspired by Brazilian folklore, develop your characters, and make choices with lasting consequences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 ou Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 ou AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 2500 ou equivalente, com suporte a OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Psychological manipulation: In the context of the game, the player is lured by the siren song of Iara.
The player is also stupefied by the alchemist, who forces them to hand over specific items.
I believe this game falls under the 16+ rating.
